_comment: Bundle config for the four Tier-B media/browse servers (youtube, youtube-transcript, context7, playwright_with_chunk). One replay-proxy process loads all four so a single docker container can satisfy any media-bundle task.

tools.name: videos_getVideo
tools.description: Get detailed information about a YouTube video (YouTube Data API v3 videos.list).

tools.name: videos_searchVideos
tools.description: Search for videos on YouTube (search.list + videos.list detail join).

tools.name: transcripts_getTranscript
tools.description: Get the transcript of a YouTube video via the youtube-transcript npm package.

tools.name: channels_getChannel
tools.description: Get information about a YouTube channel (channels.list).

tools.name: channels_listVideos
tools.description: Start a new channel videos list session with sorting options (max 20 per page).

tools.name: channels_navigateList
tools.description: Navigate within an existing channel-videos list session (prev/next/jump to page).

tools.name: playlists_getPlaylist
tools.description: Get information about a YouTube playlist (playlists.list).

tools.name: playlists_getPlaylistItems
tools.description: Get videos in a YouTube playlist (playlistItems.list).

tools.name: playlists_searchPlaylists
tools.description: Search for playlists on YouTube (search.list with type=playlist).

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: Retrieves the transcript of a YouTube video as a single concatenated string. Returns {title, transcript, next_cursor}.

tools.name: get_timed_transcript
tools.description: Retrieves the transcript with per-snippet timestamps. Returns {title, snippets:[{text,start,duration}], next_cursor}.

tools.name: get_video_info
tools.description: Retrieves video metadata via yt-dlp. Returns {title, description, uploader, upload_date, duration}.

tools.name: get_available_languages
tools.description: Lists available transcript languages for the video. Returns a list of language codes / labels.

tools.name: resolve-library-id
tools.description: Resolves a package/product name to a Context7-compatible library ID and returns matching libraries (format /org/project). Schema pinned to @upstash/context7-mcp@1.0.14.

tools.name: get-library-docs
tools.description: Fetches documentation and code examples for a resolved Context7-compatible library ID. Response is a markdown text payload from the Context7 docs API.

tools.name: browser_navigate
tools.description: Navigate to a URL. Returns markdown with Ran Playwright code + accessibility snapshot first span.

tools.name: browser_navigate_back
tools.description: Go back to the previous page.

tools.name: browser_navigate_forward
tools.description: Go forward to the next page.

tools.name: browser_snapshot
tools.description: Capture accessibility snapshot. Sliced into spans (--span-size, 5000 chars in Toolathlon); first span returned.

tools.name: browser_snapshot_navigate_to_span
tools.description: Navigate to a specific span (0-based) of the latest snapshot.

tools.name: browser_snapshot_navigate_to_first_span
tools.description: Navigate to first snapshot span.

tools.name: browser_snapshot_navigate_to_last_span
tools.description: Navigate to last snapshot span.

tools.name: browser_snapshot_navigate_to_next_span
tools.description: Navigate to next snapshot span.

tools.name: browser_snapshot_navigate_to_prev_span
tools.description: Navigate to previous snapshot span.

tools.name: browser_snapshot_navigate_to_line
tools.description: Navigate to a specific global line number (1-based) of the snapshot.

tools.name: browser_snapshot_search
tools.description: Regex search across all spans of the current snapshot.

tools.name: browser_click
tools.description: Perform click on a web page using ref from snapshot.

tools.name: browser_hover
tools.description: Hover over an element.

tools.name: browser_drag
tools.description: Drag-and-drop between two elements.

tools.name: browser_type
tools.description: Type text into an editable element.

tools.name: browser_select_option
tools.description: Select option(s) from a dropdown.

tools.name: browser_press_key
tools.description: Press a keyboard key.

tools.name: browser_wait_for
tools.description: Wait for time / text-appear / text-disappear.

tools.name: browser_evaluate
tools.description: Evaluate JS in the page or against an element.

tools.name: browser_take_screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of viewport / element / full page.

tools.name: browser_file_upload
tools.description: Upload files (absolute paths).

tools.name: browser_handle_dialog
tools.description: Accept or dismiss the most recent dialog.

tools.name: browser_console_messages
tools.description: Return collected console messages.

tools.name: browser_network_requests
tools.description: Return collected network requests.

tools.name: browser_resize
tools.description: Resize the browser viewport.

tools.name: browser_close
tools.description: Close the browser context/page.

tools.name: browser_install
tools.description: Install browser binaries.

tools.name: browser_scroll_up
tools.description: Scroll up by amount px (default one viewport).

tools.name: browser_scroll_down
tools.description: Scroll down by amount px (default one viewport).

tools.name: browser_scroll_to_top
tools.description: Scroll to top.

tools.name: browser_scroll_to_bottom
tools.description: Scroll to bottom.

tools.name: browser_tab_list
tools.description: List all open tabs.

tools.name: browser_tab_new
tools.description: Open a new tab, optionally navigating.

tools.name: browser_tab_select
tools.description: Switch to tab at index.

tools.name: browser_tab_close
tools.description: Close tab at index (or current tab).
